body: We should also look into merging those settings together. For users on Android, they will either all be enabled together or all be disabled.
Sounds good to me 👍
Let's talk about the hardest part, I think we can call it `enable_touch_optimizations`. I agree it’s a bit too generic. Feel free to suggest any better names you can come up with.

Note that having it here will only apply to the dock splits, and not to other SplitContainers in the editor, like the one in the Filesystem, 2d/3d editors with multiple views, some of the debuggers, and other places.
If this is intentional, then its fine.
I think this should use NOTIFICATION_EDITOR_SETTINGS_CHANGED, so it has an effect immediately without restart.
Yeah, it's intentional. I didn't find it necessary in other places.

This setting also increases the scrollbar area, which only takes effect after a restart. Using NOTIFICATION_EDITOR_SETTINGS_CHANGED here would be inconsistent -- This would apply immediately, while scrollbar change would still require a restart.

@syntaxerror247 I made the scrollbar area update require a restart because otherwise it would freeze the editor for a few seconds while the update was being done.

We should test if the freeze behavior still happens, and if not we can set both touch optimizations to happen without a restart.
I think a semi-transparent pill-shaped button may be better instead.

@syntaxerror247 We should add the capability to `SplitContainer` and provide a property to enable / disable it, similarly what I did in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106114.

By adding it directly to the `SplitContainer`, we can make the touch dragger dynamic, as in it can have a default `TextureRect` and another one for when it's pressed down (e.g: semi-transparent by default and fully opaque when pressed down).

Yes, editor still freezes for sometime when theme is changed. We can update this setting to not require a restart in the PR that improves the scrollbar because as planned we will move away from the theme change and instead use a touch handle.
@m4gr3d I don't think we need to add this to SplitContainer as the necessary thing (get_drag_area_control method) to have this is already exposed.
I went with fully opaque and modified it's modulate based on editor base color, so it looks more integrated.
I'll test with transparent pill-shaped button.
@m4gr3d I replaced it with semi-transparent pill-shaped buttons. Please check if this is what you meant?
Added a property to the SplitContainer to enable touch_dragger.

Since other mouse buttons have no effect.

body: This should also mention that the regular grabber will no longer be drawn.
I don't think `dragger_visibility` should affect the `touch_dragger` because `touch_dragger` is desined to be always visible, so other options, HIDDEN and HIDDEN_COLLAPSED, doesn't make sense for it.
Without deferring, It causes issues for hsplit containers. Icons for them aren't visible.
Now deferring for `DockSplitContainer` using callable_mp. It's seems fine to directly call in other places.
I guess the user can get the node if they need to hide it for some reason, so its fine.
